'''Rain Drop''' was a business located in an alley in [[Ord Mantell City]] on the [[planet]] [[Ord Mantell]]. The name of the establishment was written in [[Aurebesh]] and displayed on a sign, which was was mirror-inverted. The business was located across the street from [[Cid's Parlor]], a [[cantina]] operated by the [[Trandoshan]] [[information broker]] [[Ciddarin Scaleback]]. [[Clone Force 99]] walked past the Rain Drop while searching for Scaleback<ref name="Rampage" /> in [[19 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' places the events of [[The Bad Batch Season 1|''The Bad Batch'' Season 1]] in [[19 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Rain Drop appeared in "[[Rampage (episode)|Rampage]]," an episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''.<ref name="Rampage" />
